name: test-gate
description: When Claude ends a turn after editing code without running a test or check, a small model decides whether it should, and if so the turn goes on once with a note asking Claude to run the tests or say why not

enabled.title: Test gate
enabled.description: Off: turns end as they always do.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model asked whether the edits need a test run: an alias or a full model id. Called through Claude Code, on the signed-in account.

timeoutSeconds.title: Model timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: The model call is given up after this long, and a code-only rule decides instead. 2 to 60.

testPatterns.title: Test and check commands
testPatterns.description: Bash commands that count as a test or check run, separated by commas. A command counts when it, or a part of it after && ; or |, starts with one of these. Empty: the defaults.
testPatterns.default: npm test, npm t, npm run test, npm run check, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, bun test, bun run test, pnpm test, pnpm run test, yarn test, yarn run test, deno test, vitest, jest, mocha, playwright test, tsc, eslint, pytest, tox, nox, mypy, ruff check, unittest, cargo test, cargo check, cargo clippy, cargo nextest, go test, go vet, make test, make check, make lint, mvn test, mvn verify, gradle test, ./gradlew test, dotnet test, mix test, rspec, rake test, phpunit, swift test, claude plugin test, claude plugin validate
